_comment: Fields Claude extracts from each KID. Edit freely: add/remove/reorder. 'key' must be unique snake_case. 'type' is one of: string, number, date, boolean, list. 'summary': true puts the field in the email's summary table. Dates are normalised to DD-MM-YYYY. Missing values become 'Not found'.

fields.label: Issuer
fields.description: Full legal name of the issuer company

fields.label: ISIN(s)
fields.description: All ISINs mentioned for this issue/series

fields.label: Series / Tranche
fields.description: Series, tranche or option name(s)

fields.label: Instrument
fields.description: e.g. Secured Redeemable NCDs, Unsecured Subordinated Tier II bonds, Perpetual AT1

fields.label: Secured / Unsecured
fields.description: Secured or Unsecured

fields.label: Base Issue Size
fields.description: Base issue size with currency and units exactly as stated (e.g. 'INR 100 crore')

fields.label: Green Shoe Option
fields.description: Green shoe / over-subscription retention amount

fields.label: Total Issue Size
fields.description: Total issue size including green shoe, with units

fields.label: Face Value per Unit
fields.description: Face value / nominal value per debenture

fields.label: Issue Price
fields.description: Issue price per debenture (at par/premium/discount)

fields.label: Minimum Application
fields.description: Minimum subscription / application size

fields.label: Coupon Rate
fields.description: Coupon / interest rate (% p.a.), per series if multiple

fields.label: Coupon Type
fields.description: Fixed / Floating / Zero coupon / Step-up etc.

fields.label: Interest Payment Frequency
fields.description: Monthly / Quarterly / Annual / Cumulative at maturity

fields.label: Tenor
fields.description: Tenor / maturity period

fields.label: Issue Opening Date
fields.description: Issue / bid opening date

fields.label: Issue Closing Date
fields.description: Issue / bid closing date

fields.label: Pay-in Date
fields.description: Pay-in date

fields.label: Deemed Date of Allotment
fields.description: Deemed date of allotment

fields.label: Redemption / Maturity Date
fields.description: Final redemption / maturity date

fields.label: Redemption Amount/Premium
fields.description: Redemption amount or premium, if any

fields.label: Put / Call Option
fields.description: Put/call option details and dates, or 'None'

fields.label: Credit Rating(s)
fields.description: All ratings with agency, e.g. 'CRISIL AA+/Stable; ICRA AA+/Stable'

fields.label: Listing
fields.description: Proposed listing exchange(s)

fields.label: Debenture Trustee
fields.description: Name of the debenture trustee

fields.label: Arranger(s)
fields.description: Arrangers / lead managers, if any

fields.label: Security / Cover
fields.description: Nature of security and security cover ratio

fields.label: Objects of the Issue
fields.description: Purpose / use of proceeds (one or two sentences)

fields.label: Bidding / EBP Platform
fields.description: Electronic book platform used (e.g. BSE EBP) and bid type

fields.label: Key Risks (brief)
fields.description: At most 3 short bullet-style points separated by '; '
